title: logs.tail (platform → host)
description: Sends the last `lines` lines as logs.chunk frames (stream_id = this message's id), after host.result ok. With follow, new lines follow until max_s, logs.stop or the connection ends; the last chunk has eof: true. At most 4 followed streams (rejected limit). Sources: console (the server's csm log file), readyup (Ready Up's newest log), csm (csm's action log), monitor (the auto-update monitor log); console and readyup need server. Lines are redacted (tokens, keys, codes). Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
